greeting: What are you looking for today?
greetingName: Hi {name}! What are you looking for today?
subtitle: Tell me in your own words. I'll search the web for real opportunities near you and online.
placeholder: e.g. law internships for high schoolers
searching: Searching the web for real opportunities…
noLocation: No location set — showing online and Texas-wide options
locationDenied: Location permission was blocked. Type a ZIP code or town instead.
locationHelp: Only your town is used to search. Your exact location never leaves your phone.

limitNotice: You've reached today's AI search limit, so these are sample results. It resets tomorrow!

errorNotice: The AI search had a problem, so these are sample results. Please try again in a bit.
demoNotice: Demo mode: the AI isn't connected yet, so these are real programs from our sample list. Always check dates on the official site.
suggestionsHelp: These are not confirmed listings. They're the kinds of places that sometimes offer this. Contact them first to ask.
notConfirmed: Not a confirmed listing. Contact them first to ask.
scriptTip: Fill in the [brackets]. If you're under 16, ask a parent to read it first. Never share your home address.
blocked: I can't help with that one. Try searching for an activity, program, or job you'd like to do!
crisisTitle: It sounds like something serious might be going on.
